blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Creamline shook off a sluggish start and turned back Galeries Tower, 27-29, 25-18, 25-19, 25-18, to remain unbeaten in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Saturday at Filoil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City. Tots Carlos spearheaded the Cool Smashers’ balanced attack with 13 points, all from kills, while Jema Galanza delivered another all-around performance of 12 points, 12 digs and 11 excellent receptions. Alyssa Valdez chipped in 10 points, while Bernadeth Pons made a successful return to indoor action with eight points and 12 digs on 16 attempts after her campaign with the Alas Pilipinas […]...
